_comment: Manifest for the generate_audio_batch tool: a list of assets to generate
through the Hugging Face Spaces. Each entry is one prompt, one model and the
parameters of the run; the tool writes a <name>_<seed>.<ext> file plus a
.json sidecar with the prompt, the parameters and the raw answer of the Space.
licence must be one of the shippable_licences below: the tool refuses
non-commercial models (mmaudio is CC-BY-NC-4.0 and is rejected), so a
prototype result can never be mistaken for a shippable one.
Pick the prompts so the takes share a tempo when they are meant to be

assets.name: machine_hum_loop
assets.prompt: Low steady hum of a large industrial machine, soft mechanical vibration, distant metallic rattle, smooth continuous sound, seamless loop

assets.name: wind_loop
assets.prompt: Steady wind over an open plain, layered airflow, soft gusts, seamless loop, no voices, no music

assets.name: music_calm
assets.prompt: Electronic game soundtrack, instrumental, 130 BPM, relaxed breakbeat groove, warm analog pads, soft synth arpeggio, light drums, no vocals

assets.name: music_steady
assets.prompt: Electronic game soundtrack, instrumental, 130 BPM, driving breakbeat, punchy kick and snare, rolling bassline, bright synth stabs, confident forward momentum, no vocals

assets.name: music_intense
assets.prompt: Electronic game soundtrack, instrumental, 130 BPM, high energy acid bassline, relentless breakbeat drums, tense lead synth, a tense, urgent pace, no vocals
